title: MVS logical-record I/O and allocation lifecycle
summary: The MVS RecordSet dev11 package supplies QSAM and SVC 99 access. ooRexx's MvsRecordProvider is a typed logical-record seam exposing explicit EOF, one-based record positioning, unknown count, metadata and retryable cleanup. It is not a POSIX stream implementation.
invariants: EOF is not a zero-length logical record.
Never discard a DD allocation or QSAM handle when CLOSE or unallocation fails; permit retry.
Channel close-pending is not equivalent to DD ownership; state must not be misinterpreted.
Do not reinterpret absolute paths as dataset names or fake arbitrary seek offsets.
The adapter's host fake-QSAM tests do not establish successful native RecordSet operation under MVS.
